previous_statement: Admissible setup from the registered dependencies: in the finite-dimensional raw-factor setting, let 0 <= eta <= rho_id^corr = min{rho_theta,rho_AI,epsilon_E/C_A}. Since rho_theta=1/8, eta<1/4, so lem-kitaev-almost-idemp-audit gives tilde-Phi^2=tilde-Phi and A=Im(tilde-Phi). By lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization, A is an extended epsilon_AI(eta)-C*-algebra with epsilon_AI(eta) <= C_A*eta; the radius gives eta <= rho_AI and C_A*eta <= epsilon_E. Hence lem-thmainext-conditional supplies a finite-dimensional C*-algebra B and an extended C_E*epsilon_AI(eta)-isomorphism v:B->A. By def-extended-delta-inclusion, v is bijective (in particular onto A), so v^(-1):A->B exists.
new_statement: Conditional setup lemma (and no stronger assertion): take the universal witnesses C_A>0 and eta_A>0 from lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization and C_E<infinity and epsilon_E>0 from lem-thmainext-conditional, and set rho_theta:=1/8, rho_AI:=eta_A, and rho_id^corr:=min{rho_theta,rho_AI,epsilon_E/C_A}. Let H be a nonzero finite-dimensional Hilbert space, let Phi:B(H)->B(H) be UCP, and suppose 0<=eta<=rho_id^corr and ||Phi^2-Phi||_cb<=eta. Define tilde-Phi, A=Im(tilde-Phi), star, and epsilon_AI(eta) exactly as in lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization. Then tilde-Phi^2=tilde-Phi, A is a finite-dimensional extended epsilon_AI(eta)-C*-algebra with epsilon_AI(eta)<=C_A*eta<=epsilon_E, and lem-thmainext-conditional supplies a finite-dimensional C*-algebra B and an extended C_E*epsilon_AI(eta)-isomorphism v:B->A; hence v is bijective and v^(-1):A->B exists. These UCP/cb and finite-dimensional hypotheses are hypotheses of this conditional lemma; they are not claimed to follow from the present root contract.
